hook.cap: India may face a 17% or 25% US tariff. And the Nasdaq 100 briefly fell 20% from its record.

stories.headline: India's tariff: 17% or 25%
stories.cap: The US has proposed new tariffs on 14 trading partners, India included. India would face 17% with a trade deal, and up to 25% without one. Five Asian rivals face 18%.

sources.title: New US tariff may give India edge over Asian peers if trade deal done: GTRI
Tariff Turmoil: US links lower 17% tariff for India to reciprocal trade deal, proposes up to 25% otherwise

summary.line: The US proposed a 17% tariff on India if a trade deal is signed, and up to 25% without one. Five Asian rivals face 18%.

stories.headline: AI shares slide in the US
stories.cap: Wall Street fell sharply on Wednesday as AI stocks were sold. The Nasdaq 100 briefly dropped 20% from its record close. US core inflation hit 3.3%, above the 3.2% expected.

sources.title: Nasdaq plunges 4% as AI stocks sell off and fresh US tariff fears hit Wall Street
Nasdaq 100 plunges nearly 5%, briefly enters bear-market zone as AI fears and fresh tariffs hit sentiment

summary.line: AI shares were sold off on Wall Street. The Nasdaq 100 briefly fell 20% from its record close, and US core inflation came in at 3.3%.

stories.headline: Tata Steel may rework deal
stories.cap: Tata Steel may rework its deal with APL Apollo Tubes. APL Apollo would pay about ₹28,000 crore, mostly debt, for Tata Steel's tubes businesses. Investors are worried, and talks are on with no conclusion yet.

sources.title: Tata Steel open to revisiting APL Apollo deal structure after investor backlash
Tata Steel, APL Apollo in talks to rework deal structure amid shareholder concerns

summary.line: Tata Steel and APL Apollo are discussing changes to their deal after investor worries about the ₹28,000 crore, mostly debt-funded purchase.

stories.headline: Simpler KYC from 24 Dec
stories.cap: SEBI is easing KYC rules from 24 December. Common extra KYC details will be stored centrally at KYC registration agencies. Investors will not need to submit them again to every intermediary.

sources.title: Sebi to ease KYC norms, centralise client details at registration agencies
SEBI simplifies KYC norms, streamlines investor onboarding

summary.line: SEBI will centralise common extra KYC details at registration agencies from 24 December, so investors submit them only once.

stories.headline: Airtel's Assam data centres
stories.cap: Airtel will invest about ₹1,200 crore in three data centres in Assam. They are planned in Guwahati, Jorhat and Silchar, and could be ready by 2028.

sources.title: Bharti Airtel to invest ₹1,200 crore in three data centres in Assam
Bharti Airtel to invest ₹1,200 crore in three data centres in Assam

summary.line: Airtel signed a pact to invest about ₹1,200 crore in three Assam data centres, due by 2028.
